Description
This sun-filled 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom and den located in Kitsilano, Vancouver furnished condo rental has Hardwood floors, stylish, high-end Luxury furnishings from INspiration Furniture store, including Natuzzi white leather Couch and accent chair. You will appreciate ample natural light in the den or watch Netflix or cable TV sitting on the comfy couch next to the gas fireplace in the comfort of the living room or dining at the glass dining table. The kitchen features a generous layout with Quartz counter tops, stainless steel appliances and tile flooring for easy cleaning. The den has a at home office which can be fully closed off for privacy, and includes a large working desk.

Description
Nestled on one of Kitsilano's most picturesque and sought-after streets, this exceptional two-level townhome is located just one block from the beach on charming York Avenue, surrounded by cherry blossom trees and beautiful executive residences. Offering approximately 1,499 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this home features 2 bedrooms, a den, 2 bathrooms, and stunning views of the water, mountains, and city skyline. The main level offers an inviting open-concept kitchen, a spacious dining area ideal for entertaining, a private deck, and a well-appointed bedroom and full bathroom. A private rooftop deck provides the perfect setting to relax. One covered carport parking space included. If viewing on Zillow please text/email the leasing agent. **Unfurnished is not an option**

Description
Experience refined West Coast living in this custom Brandes luxury home, tucked in Point Grey’s coveted North of 4th. A reverse floor plan maximizes water views from the open-concept main floor featuring 11'+ vaulted ceilings. A private elevator connects all three levels, leading to a chef’s kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, custom millwork, a wine cellar, and a private theater. Relax on the rooftop deck with a hot tub and panoramic ocean, mountain, and city views. Finished with stone, marble, and full home automation, this 4-bed, 5-bath unfurnished residence blends warmth and modern luxury steps from Spanish Banks, Jericho Beach, UBC, and top schools like Lord Byng. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.

Description
Unfurnished 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom detached home in MacKenzie Heights, Vancouver. Approx. 3,149 sq ft with all four bedrooms upstairs, including a primary bedroom with ensuite. Spacious kitchen and adjoining family room overlook a private south-facing backyard. Lower-level recreation space, storage and laundry. Carpet replaced July 2025; entire house repainted. Fridge, stove, oven, dishwasher, washer and dryer included. Rent $6,000/month plus utilities. Available after October 16, 2026; exact move-in date to be confirmed. Minimum one-year lease. No pets or smoking. Tenant insurance, credit and reference checks required.
